index.hero_title: Personalized Learning System for Linear Algebra
index.hero_desc: Vectoria is designed to accompany learners throughout their exploration of Linear Algebra. It serves as a unified hub for theories and exercises, empowering learners to explore this mathematical domain through dynamic visualization tools.
index.feat1_title: Data Repository and Personal Progress Tracking
index.feat1_desc: A dedicated workspace for storing completed exercises and saved lessons, integrated with interaction history logging to help learners monitor their progress via intuitive visual statistics.
index.btn_feat1: Set up your workspace
index.feat2_desc: Supports algebraic computations and visualizes operations between mathematical objects to simulate their intrinsic properties.
index.btn_feat2: Let's crunch some numbers
index.feat3_desc: A comprehensive collection of Linear Algebra theories and reference materials, suggesting optimal learning pathways and enabling learners to create custom review sets at their discretion.
index.btn_feat3: Dive into the library
